verdict.rationale: Pylon's API allows programmatic read access to issues, accounts, and contacts (pylon-docs-31, pylon-docs-35, pylon-docs-36), which could support building a data export, but there is no documented bulk-export feature, data-portability tool, or explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) full-account export/leave workflow. missing for 10: dedicated data export/backup feature, explicit open-format export documentation, evidence of a full account data takeout process.
